rationale: The candidate requires structured delivery because it changes product semantics, runtime behavior, and policy across six canonical owners. It is ineligible for verified_change because ownership is not singular and propagation is not deterministic; compact_delivery is also unsupported because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not evidenced.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Product semantics, runtime, and policy impacts are explicitly present.
Six canonical owners and eight source paths indicate cross-owner breadth.
Derived paths exist, but deterministic propagation is false.
verified_change requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation when derived paths exist.
compact_delivery requires visible approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, and stored quick_task context; only the UR
Any impact beyond the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
This is a non-authorizing benchmark candidate, not an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
